Principal Suspended Over Alleged Poor Mid-Day Meal Service

A principal has been suspended following a viral video showing children being served a mid-day meal without plates. The incident, which occurred at a government primary school in Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh, allegedly involved children being given food on their hands. Reports indicate the meal consisted of watery vegetables and burnt rotis, with some outlets comparing it unfavorably to food served to prisoners. The suspension followed the circulation of images and videos depicting the alleged poor quality and presentation of the meal.
